An unusual evening ahead, a short update
The subject is lounge space
Travelers on Aurelia Skyways should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before heading to the gate, since a few lounge and pet-handling details are changing tonight.

Pet travel note for lounge use

Please keep carriers closed and pets calm while in shared areas. Our handlers use steady, humane care and give clear guidance so the trip stays smooth for everyone. <<FACT F072>> If you are bringing a larger dog, we will also confirm the correct fee at the desk before you move on. <<FACT F057>>

For comfort and safety, please keep all animal gear together, follow the crew's directions, and stay close to the desk if you need help with a crate, carrier, or route through the terminal. We will help you sort out the next steps with care.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the latest guidance before departure.
